title: End-to-end flows
request: Check the product against the plan with real runs, without a model: the Telco CSV uploaded, no data, synthetic data, and a log file; fix each defect in the product, not the script, with a unit test that would have caught it.
spec: scripts/product_e2e.py and make product-e2e: upload, no data, synthetic, log file, all without a model. Done when make product-e2e ends with 'all flows passed'.
plan: Run the four flows by hand on a temporary server: the Telco CSV, no data, a synthetic table, a web-server log.
Drive the same flows in the browser: Home, the chat, the wizard's five steps with untouched defaults, the Workflow page.
For every failure, find the cause in the product and add a unit test.
Turn the throwaway scripts into scripts/product_e2e.py and make product-e2e so the check is repeatable.

decisions.decision: The flows run without a model.
decisions.why: They test the plumbing and the defaults every user meets; model paths are checked separately (8.1).

decisions.decision: The scores the script prints are not results.
decisions.why: Quick mode and one holdout show that the flow runs, nothing about model quality.

change: scripts/product_e2e.py and make product-e2e (about 90 s) running the four flows on a temporary server; the audit's fixes landed in the wizard, the agent and synthetic data.

findings.defect: The end-to-end runs that found most defects lived in throwaway scripts.
findings.scenario: Each audit of the product was a one-off script in a scratch folder; after a change nobody could rerun the same four flows.
findings.cause: Exploratory checks were never promoted to a command.
findings.fix: scripts/product_e2e.py (make product-e2e) runs the four flows on a temporary server and ends with 'all flows passed' or the failing step.

measurements.name: the four flows
measurements.gate: make product-e2e ends with 'all flows passed'.
measurements.result: All four flows passed (upload, no data, synthetic split by time, log file) in about 90 s; rd-check passed with 316 tests.
measurements.next: Rerun after every change to Home, the wizard or the engine.

outcome: Done: the four flows are one repeatable command. The audit before it found and fixed: folds not reaching the engine, a split control disconnected from the solution, a unique timestamp refused by its own defaults, guidance saved as the prediction moment, a stale Task box, 'Audit again' crashing for uploads, the auditor crashing on yes/no columns, a chat race, and a silent synthetic template.
lessons: Promote every manual end-to-end check that found a bug into a command; the next change will need it.
